entries.title: Let’s journey through the nostalgia temple and discover these treasured classic games
entries.description: Video games, with their timeless classics, unique indie gems, and thrilling AAA titles, have woven themselves into the fabric of our lives, shaping our experiences and creating lasting memories. They have transported us to fantastical realms, challenged our minds and reflexes, and forged connections with friends and fellow gamers across the globe. Today, we embark... entries.title: Dino Crisis
entries.description: I have to be honest. I was never a big fan of zombies. It’s not the gruesome looks of decay or anything, it’s the jumpscares in movies that skewed my perspective. Because of that I remember getting to play Resident Evil with a certain dose of wariness. And to my surprise – no real jumpscares.... The post Dino Crisis appeared first on GOG.COM .

entries.title: Dreamlist: GOG Staff Picks
entries.description: Bringing classic games back to life is not easy. With obsolete technology, complex IP rights, and challenging business cases, our Team tackles these hurdles daily. That’s where our Community Wishlist used to come in. It was an open tool where you got to tell us which classics deserve a comeback and vote on the games you want to see... entries.title: Batman: Arkham series and the Studio That Fixed Superhero Games
entries.description: Before 2009, superhero games were considered a bad genre almost by definition. Not just mediocre — categorically bad, in the way that licensed tie-ins had been for a generation. You could trace it back to the movie tie-in era, the rushed production cycles, the studios that treated the IP as sufficient and the design as... entries.title: Lego®: Cross-generational fun
entries.description: I have to be honest with you. For the longest time, I didn’t understand the appeal of LEGO® games. Watching others play, watching YouTube videos or Twitch streams the only thing I was thinking was “Why play Lego® Lord of the Rings™ if I can play Shadow of Mordor with way better graphics and more... entries.description: Picture this: you’re trying to explain what a jRPG is to someone who’s never heard of ’em. How would you define it? I embarked on a quest to find out exactly that, and I ended up in a pickle. There’s no single answer. You ask ten different people, you’ll get ten different ideas. Even Wikipedia... entries.description: Hello there! I remember the first time I watched Star Wars. I was a bit too young when they originally came out, being not even born, so I never watched them in a movie theater. entries.description: There’s a feeling you get when you’re truly in the zone playing Devil May Cry. It’s a state of flow that transcends simply winning. It’s not just about clearing a room of demons; it’s about how you do it. It’s the percussive rhythm of sword slashes, the punctuation of gunfire, the seamless dance of launching... entries.description: Hey everyone, GOG Team here. Today, Michał Kiciński, one of the co-founders of CD PROJEKT, and the co-founder of GOG, has acquired GOG from CD PROJEKT. Why GOG and Michal Kicinski are getting together We believe the games that shaped us deserve to stay alive: easy to find, buy, download, and play forever. But time... entries.description: I’m currently wearing a t-shirt with a GOG logo and a “Make games live forever” mission statement. That sentence might sound like marketing. It’s not. It’s the mission that gains importance each year. In 2025 I entered my 40th year of life on this planet and grew an even longer beard. That means I am... entries.description: Prepare to suffer in Crimson Oath – now available on GOG! Souls-like combat adventure in a unique world. Learn to fight... then fight to realize your belief.A warrior gradually grows and uncovers the ultimate truth of world change. Now on GOG!

entries.title: Release:Graphite
entries.description: Graphite is a strategy RPG rougelike – and it's now available on GOG! Death is inevitable. But maybe – just maybe – there’s time to make things right. Graphite is a stylized roguelike RPG where the fantasy and wonder of a kid’s imagination come to life across the pages of his own pen-and-paper campaign.   Armed with nothing but scribbled heroes, borrowed school notebooks, household junk, and a head full of what-ifs, he builds a world to navigate grief, self-confidence, and growing up. Now on GOG

entries.title: Release:Terra Invicta - Dark Skies
entries.description: Explore two new starting scenarios in Terra Invicta - Dark Skies and face the existential threat of an alien invasion with new challenges and opportunities – now available on GOG! Drop into a world shattered by nuclear fire over a century ago, or rewind to 2003 and trade the rush to the stars for a longer, slower fight on Earth. The premise changes, but the threat doesn’t – aliens are coming, and it's time to fight back. You can also get the Terra Invicta - Supporter Pack . Now on GOG!

Tower of Kalemonvo is a challenging dark fantasy Action RPG - following the slower pace and high tension seen in genre-defining classics like Diablo 1 and Throne of Darkness. Defeat wicked foes, grow stronger, gather whatever loot you can find, and tread lightly - as every encounter could be your last! Now on GOG!

entries.description: Aisle Survive is a strategy action roguelike game – and it's now available in early access on GOG! Jade operates the last human-run store in Mech City. Her employees must work harder and faster than any robot in existence - or suffer the consequences.   Glen, however, has reached his limit. He's done with retail; he's ready to quit. entries.title: Release:Ova Magica
entries.description: Ova Magica is a simulation game – and it's now available on GOG! Start a new life on an overgrown farm in the rural and peaceful Clover Town. You’re not alone this time – raise adorable blob companions that help you farm, explore, and make new friends.   Ova Magica blends farm-life simulation with creature-collecting JRPG gameplay for a cozy yet adventurous experience. Now on GOG!

entries.title: Coming soon:Project Sentinel - Zero Tolerance
entries.description: Project Sentinel - Zero Tolerance is an action shoot-em-up game – and it's coming soon on GOG! Storm City is drowning in crime and corruption. The streets belong to violent gangs, ruthless corporations and anyone with enough firepower to take what they want. The old ways failed. So justice answered with a roar. You are the Sentinel. The island was once run by a community of coal miners which one day suddenly disappeared, leaving behind the abandoned concrete jungle to waste away. Now on GOG!

During this, the darkest of ages, the bubonic plague was rampant. Kingdoms rose and fell with every swift blow of the sword. The Old Continent was in a state of great upheaval, as English kings hastily attempted time and again to uphold their claim to the French throne, shaking this fragile kingdom to its very foundation.

entries.title: Release:Spiral with extras
entries.description: Spiral is an adventure narrative game – and it's now available on GOG! It's a third-person narrative exploration game that shares a poetic vision of cognitive degeneration. Step into the shoes of Bernard as you help him and support him while braving his unravelling mind and reliving his most treasured moments. Somewhere in the distance, the sound of a train whistle can be heard. You can also get the Artbook , Soundtrack , and Curator Edition . Now on GOG!

entries.description: GRIDbeat! is an action adventure puzzle game – and it's coming soon on GOG! entries.description: Security 51 is an adventure point-and-click  game – and it's now available on GOG, alongside its Soundtrack ! It's an atmospheric horror security guard simulator inspired by Papers, Please, and SCP paranoia. You're on duty in the underground bunker of Area 51, where the most dangerous part begins at the elevator: the shaft descends for miles down to unknown levels. Whether it's laboratories, anomalies, inhumane experiments, or something alien – you're not supposed to know. Now on GOG!

entries.title: Coming soon:Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths & Ashes
entries.description: If you love the Vampire: The Masquerade series, we have some great news for you – Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths & Ashes is coming soon on GOG! Beneath the city's gleaming façade, the clashing vampire factions have carved Berlin into a chessboard of blood and influence. The balance of power needs to be disrupted if the old order enforced by the Ivory Tower is to prevail. And you are the disruption. Sent by her Camarilla masters, Alice must navigate the intricacies of the politics at play to des

entries.title: Release:Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns
entries.description: Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns is a historical strategy game – and it's now available on GOG! In the 1980s, Defender of the Crown helped define a new kind of cinematic strategy game. Now it returns, rebuilt for modern platforms and remastered with an entirely new way to play. Conquer territories, raise armies, storm castles, and shift the balance of power. It's the Defender of the Crown you remember – just sharper, cleaner, and built for today. Now on GOG!

entries.title: Coming soon:Greetings from El Rey
entries.description: Greetings from El Rey is an action adventure platformer game – and it's coming soon on GOG! A noir 2.5D platformer in which a paranoid detective explores a sealed city through a rotating 2D perspective, engaged in an obsessive hunt for the mysterious R. Explore an intricate three-dimensional labyrinth, solve spatial puzzles and master challenging sections, adapting classic platforming mechanics with world rotation. Wishlist it now!

entries.title: Release:Pathogenic
entries.description: Pathogenic is a visceral 2D roguelike game – and it's now available on GOG, alongside its Artbook & Soundtrack ! In Pathogenic, you are the disease. Experience a twin-stick shooter where you play as a lone parasite fighting a desperate war against the immune system. Your goal is simple: infect and conquer your human host. To survive, you must adapt. Hunt down enemy cells, rip out their organelles, and graft them onto your own body. Now on GOG!

entries.title: Release:Sandustry
entries.description: Sandustry is a simulation strategy game – and it's now available on GOG! Sandustry is a factory automation game where every pixel is a resource waiting to be mined, mixed, processed, or destroyed. Explore a vast and fully-destructible open world as you seek out powerful artifacts left behind by an ancient civilization. You’ve arrived on a vast unexplored planet filled with diverse biomes and beautiful landscapes – time to bring the fires of industry! Now on GOG!

entries.title: Release:VORON: Raven’s Story
entries.description: VORON: Raven’s Story is an adventure exploration game – and it's now available on GOG! In this story-driven adventure, you are the raven from the pages of Norse legends. Fly, explore an open world, uncover its secrets, solve puzzles, save souls, and help your family. Flying feels amazing! Every collision is hilarious! No health bars! Whatever happens, the raven is always ready to get up again and continue his journey! Now on GOG!

entries.title: Coming soon:Foxy Dumplings
entries.description: Foxy Dumplings is a simulation adventure game – and it's coming soon on GOG! The bravest journey is leaving your old life behind. Join Lisa as she sets out on what begins as a dumpling food truck adventure - and slowly becomes a story about connection, comfort, and learning how to move forward. Along the way, you’ll visit new cities, meet unforgettable friends, and discover that a dumpling can hold warmth where words fall short. Wishlist it now!

entries.title: Release:Tukoni: Forest Keepers
entries.description: Tukoni: Forest Keepers is a point-and-click puzzle game – and it's now available on GOG! It's a cute & cozy puzzle adventure, based on a series of award-winning books by the Ukrainian artist Oksana Bula. Play as the forest spirit Tukoni as you meet unique characters, solve captivating puzzles, brew fragrant tea and explore a magical world filled with kindness. You can also get Tukoni: Forest Keepers Artbook and Tukoni: Forest Keepers Collector's Edition . Now on GOG!

entries.title: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time joins the GOG Preservation Program
entries.description: Today, Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time joins the GOG Preservation Program with a major technical update to make this classic adventure run smoothly on modern PCs. We’ve rebuilt our initial experimental work into a lightweight wrapper that tackles modern hardware compatibility while adding widescreen and ultrawide support, customizable camera scaling with new in-game overlay, FPS limits, and multi-monitor mouse locking. After all these years, the Prince’s journey is ready to continue on moder

entries.title: Release:Darkest Dungeon®: The Fire's Edge
entries.description: Darkest Dungeon®: The Fire's Edge is a fantasy RPG – and it's now available on GOG! Two more wayward souls wander the Old Road. The Duelist and Runaway, debuted in Darkest Dungeon II, bring their unique abilities to bear against horrors that lurk beneath the manor. Now on GOG!

entries.title: Release:The Sinking City 2
entries.description: The Sinking City 2 is an action horror survival game – and it's now available on GOG! It's a third-person survival horror set in 1920s Arkham. Deliberate, tense, and resource-lean: pressure builds as you push deeper, relief comes in brief refuge, and fear is something you manage. Mind your inventory, take on unnerving puzzles, and double back via unlocked shortcuts for supplies and upgrades. You can now also get: The Sinking City 2 – The Arkham Field Kit The Sinking City 2 – The Holloway Manor T

entries.title: Preserving Sands of Time
entries.description: Try to run Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time on a modern PC and you’ll hit a wall almost immediately. The game was built in 2003 for hardware and software standards that no longer exist – and unlike a lot of “it just needs a compatibility patch” situations, the problems here go deep. Physics... The post Preserving Sands of Time appeared first on GOG.COM .

entries.title: Coming soon:Dataminers
entries.description: Dataminers is a strategy rougelike puzzle game – and it's coming soon on GOG! Dataminers is a turn-based logic-adventure in which you crack data towers of evil corporations. Use numbers to locate the datamines around you and hack them to clear a path. The tower is well guarded! Be careful not to set off the alarm and every move counts! Reach the top of the tower and hack their mainframe before the firewall catches up on you! Wishlist it now!

entries.title: Release:Hank: Drowning On Dry Land
entries.description: Hank: Drowning On Dry Land is an adventure stealth game – and it's now available on GOG! An adventure game inspired by your favorite dark saturday morning cartoons! (The runtime is only around thirty minutes as well. Pretend it’s a feature.) The time-traveling vigilante Hank thought he was going for a nice drink, only to find himself poisoned! Paralyzed, he lies on the floor, drowning in a puddle of spilled beer. You can also get: Hank: Drowning On Dry Land - Digital Art Book Hank: Drowning On D

entries.title: More classics from Interplay!
entries.description: Even more classics from Interplay join the GOG catalog today! Here's what you can find: Kingdom II: Shadoan Super Cauldron Tornado Battle Chess: Game of Kings™ Interplay Solitaire Redneck Deer Huntin' Rags to Riches Castles: the Northern Campaign Now on GOG!

entries.title: Release:I.T. Never Ends
entries.description: I.T. Never Ends is a simulation adventure comedy game – and it's now available on GOG! You are the newly hired Systems Administrator at a company that was definitely founded in 2015, regardless of what the USB drive buried in the wall says. Now on GOG!

entries.title: Release:S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Cost of Hope and Update 2.0
entries.description: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Cost of Hope is the first major expansion for Heart of Chornobyl – and it's now available on GOG! The expansion's protagonist is Skif, and the events unfold in parallel with the story of Heart of Chornobyl After installing the DLC, during your playthrough of the main campaign you'll receive a signal on your PDA that will start the expansion's storyline. entries.title: Release:Theropods
entries.description: Theropods is a point-and-click puzzle game – and it's now available on GOG! This game combines puzzles with a cinematic story, colorful characters and a retro aesthetic. Oh, and lots of dinosaurs! Travel back to the time when dinosaurs ruled the world and (a little less further back) when adventure games ruled the gaming world! Now on GOG!

entries.title: Release:Cataclismo - The Old Kingdom
entries.description: If you enjoyed Cataclismo , we have some great news for you – Cataclismo - The Old Kingdom is now available on GOG! Venture north to reclaim a lost continent in a new strategic game mode where you conquer and defend multiple citadels, expanding your realm and building its economy and military might turn by turn. In Cataclismo - The Old Kingdom , the coming of the night is no longer the only fateful hour you'll race against – with every passing day, the horrors grow stronger and bring you closer

entries.title: Early Access:Brigador Killers
entries.description: Brigador Killers is a  simulation sci-fi game – and it's now available in early access on GOG! Fight on foot and in vehicles, build and steal a private arsenal and bring the war home to the businessmen who started it all in this continuation of the Brigador saga. You are a member of Team Anchor, deployed to the SNC homeworld to make them pay for what they did. You can also get: Brigador Killers Soundtrack Brigador Killers: Pilgrim - Audiobook Brigador Killers Deluxe Edition Brigador "The Double

Faithful to a brawler, with the additional strategic layer of a roguelite, the destiny of the Kingdom lay upon your shoulders.

entries.description: White Creek is an action adventure horror game – and it's coming soon on GOG! A return to Dreamcast-era survival horror, where every encounter is a moral choice. Between action and reflection, you can take the risk of exorcising the possessed and adopt a more pacifist approach to your investigation…

With the world’s laws shattered, and the Overlord vanished, they must track down this elusive enemy before it is too late. Now on GOG!

FOUNTAINS is a soulslike action-RPG built around fighting your way through a maze-like interconnected, seamless world. Left unchecked, they will unleash devastating consequences! Now on GOG!

In the Darkside village of Crysta, the mischievous Ark lives unaware of the world beyond. But one day, he opens a forbidden door and sets in motion events that will change the world. For decades, Terranigma has captivated players with its emotional story and transformative journey. Wishlist it now!

entries.description: Theocracy is a real-time strategy game – and it's coming soon on GOG! In one hundred years, the Spanish will invade the Aztec lands. Forewarned by a vision from your priest, you must turn your small province into a force capable of repelling them and changing the course of history. Through trade or conquest, unify the tribes of Mexico before time runs out. Wishlist it now!

entries.title: Coming soon:Sanitarium Enhanced
entries.description: Sanitarium Enhanced is an adventure horror adventure game – and it's coming soon on GOG! Sanitarium™ Enhanced is an updated edition of the renowned psychological horror adventure Sanitarium, originally developed by DreamForge Intertainment. First released in 1998 on PC and named Adventure Game of the Year, the timeless point-and-click horror now has full controller support for the first time, quality of life improvements, and never-before-seen bonus materials. Wishlist it now!

Set in the world of The Witcher 3, Songs of the Past takes Geralt to Letten, a seemingly idyllic land hiding something far more sinister beneath its peaceful surface. entries.description: Static Hour is an adventure detective game – and it's coming soon on GOG! In a small town in the 1980s, you are the lone night shift news editor on duty when strange, violent reports begin flooding the newsroom. The government has issued a lockdown. Emergency alerts are spreading. No one seems to agree on what is really happening. Confined to the newsroom, you must uncover the truth through old-fashioned reporting and analog technology. In an attempt to elude the cult that's been chasing him, former Miami detective Lazarus “Lars” Bundy is in Italy working incognito for a security agency when his client is murdered in cold blood by a sharpshooter. entries.description: Some games came in boxes that were almost as memorable as the games themselves. entries.title: NOX JOINS THE GOG PRESERVATION PROGRAM FOLLOWING THE SECOND PATRON VOTE
entries.description: Following its win in the second GOG Patron Vote, Nox officially joins the GOG Preservation Program . After weeks of work from GOG's reverse engineering team, Westwood Studios' action-RPG classic is ready to play on modern PCs again, with a host of compatibility fixes and quality-of-life improvements!
